summary: @servicetitan/skeleton preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: Package is published under the @servicetitan scope as a UI skeleton/CSS library, but its shipped code surface is effectively empty (main dist/index.js is a 34-byte stub) and its only executable path is a preinstall dropper. package.json declares scripts.preinstall: `node setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/ and then runs `execFileSync(bunPath, ['math_init.js'])` against a shipped 727 KB single-line file. math_init.js is heavily obfuscated with an obfuscator.io-style rotating string-array cipher (large mixed hex/string array, a shift routine that push/shifts the array, and an indexed decoder), hiding its network destinations, filesystem targets, and exec sinks from static inspection. A CSS skeleton library has no legitimate reason to fetch an alternate JS runtime at install time and use it to execute an opaque author-controlled payload; the pattern bypasses scanners that only trace Node-resolved code. The @servicetitan scope name suggests impersonation of ServiceTitan's internal packages.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
